gt_provenance.details: GT loaded from QA_I-00000-of-00001.parquet column 'Correct Answer' (dataset-provided label). gpt-5.4 judge classifies model text against GT — does not generate GT. Judge and evaluated model are different families.

score_normalization.details: Accuracy = n_correct / n_items (133); denominator is dataset size, not model output statistics. No self-normalization. Max accuracy 0.797 (no suspicious 0.99+ values).

result_existence.details: All M0 result files exist non-empty. M0_VERDICT.json verdict=PASS, per_seed_table present. All 7 eval summaries complete (n=133). Numbers match tracker to floating-point precision. All MUST-RUN tracker rows done.

dead_code.details: All metric functions (load_qa_i_items, render_multimodal_prompt, parse_judge_verdict, acc_from_per_item, stratified_sample, parse_verdict) are called in their respective evaluation pipelines and their outputs appear in result files.

scope.details: Scope matches claim exactly: 3 pre-registered seeds, full 133-item QA_I (complete=true all arms), 3 arms. No 'comprehensive'/'extensive' overclaim in C1 wording. Binary gate with specific thresholds.
